properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Raised by the dev_reflow2 hub's two-agent exercise (art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, idea D1), 2026-09-29. There the OWNER agent, deciding under Anthony's written delegation, made "provenance records the acting agent AND the principal it acts for" a requirement of the engine it was designing, citing its own test: "every fact names who asserts it".

WHY NOW. dec:design-authorship-identity (accepted 2026-07-22) named ACTS_FOR, "git's author/committer split", as a later rung "needing the user on vocabulary", and schema/core.yaml still says "(deferred rung)". Since then every write through flo2.io is an agent acting for a signed-in person, whether from claude.ai, Grok or Claude Code. Today the person is recorded and the agent is not (fact:root-cause-an-agent-deciding-for-its-principal-has-no-record-because-the-acts-for-rung-was-deferred-2026-09-29). flo2 is right to refuse an agent as approver, so the agent has nowhere to go at all.

OPTIONS, none chosen:
(a) NOTHING. The principal is the accountable party, and recording the agent is noise. Cheapest, and true for a single-person design.
(b) ACTS_FOR AS AN EDGE, Contributor(agent) ACTS_FOR Contributor(person), and each write or signature by the agent carries both, as git carries author and committer. Additive schema; the approver stays the person.
(c) (b) PLUS THE DELEGATION: the settlement also points at the record that authorised the agent to decide (see the companion idea on a delegation as data). Only this answers "on what authority did an agent settle this?".
(d) A FIELD ON AUTHORED_BY (on_behalf_of) instead of an edge. Smaller, but a property nobody reads is the pattern fact:the-causes-edge-carries-a-full-rca-vocabulary-that-no-served-tool-can-set warns about.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS KEPT.
· The agent's identity is SELF-DECLARED (MCP clientInfo), so this is attribution on trust, with the same bounds as writes_for. It must never become authority.
· "Which agent" is not stable: a model id, a client name or a session all change. Which one is the Contributor?
· On a local store the agent IS the only party, and forcing a principal would invent one.

SIZE: (a) free. (b) small in schema, but it touches every writer that stamps authorship. (c) needs (b) plus a delegation record that does not exist.
properties.name: OPEN — should reflow2 build the deferred ACTS_FOR rung, so a write or a settlement made by an agent for a person records BOTH the agent and the person (and, where one exists, the delegation it acted under)?
properties.rationale: Recorded open because the rung was explicitly left for Anthony's vocabulary. The field case makes it concrete: an owner agent's decisions in flo2 design 50f966697d6c5024 show only Anthony's account, and the workaround cost about 30 extra calls.
